title: Reuse dated research by role and refresh only the changed surface
when: A future agent is about to research HWPX, diagram or image APIs again.
do: Route first to the relevant pinned implementation/receipt.
Distinguish documentation, proposed tool, installed package and actual native behavior.
Refresh current official docs or local help only for an unsupported command, changed version or missing capability.
check: The selected source has matching applicability and no unresolved drift.
limitation: Old research once said native behavior was unverified; later production receipts establish a narrower observed behavior. Neither replaces the other.
